Question: Which topics have the most distinct viewers in the last 30 days?

SELECT t.id, t.title, COUNT(DISTINCT tv.user_id) AS distinct_viewers
FROM topic_views tv
JOIN topics t ON t.id = tv.topic_id
WHERE tv.viewed_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND tv.user_id IS NOT NULL
